Blocks/Items: Stuff you'd find in the natural world
Examples: Saplings, Cactus, Tall Grass, Leaves, etc.

Blocks/Items: Anything that has something to do with wood
Examples: Logs, Planks, Sticks, Fences, Boats, Signs, etc.

Blocks/Items: Anything a mob might have dropped that is not a food or a potion ingredient
Examples: Rotten Flesh, Eggs, Ender Pearls, Feathers, etc.

Blocks/Items: Any type of food
Examples: Porkchops, Beef, Chicken, Bread, Carrots, etc.

Blocks/Items: Anything that has something to do with stone
Anything that has dye-color variants
Examples: Wool, Terracotta, Dyes, Glass, Concrete, etc.

Blocks/Items: Any kind of weapon
Examples: Armor, Swords, Bow, TNT, Trident, etc.

Blocks/Items: Anything mined out of underground
All tools that you have but do not need at the moment
All tools that you need when going mining
Anything that has something to do with brewing/potions
Examples: Potions, potion ingredients, Cauldrons, Brewing Stands, etc.

Blocks/Items: All blocks and items pertaining to the Nether dimension, unless used for potions, in which those items would be in another category
Examples: Netherrack, Nether Bricks, Nether Brick Stairs and Slabs, Gold Nuggets, etc.

Blocks/Items: All blocks and items pertaining to the End dimension
Examples: End Stone, Chorus Plants, Shulker Boxes, etc.

Blocks/Items: Anything that has something to do with redstone
Examples: Redstone, Redstone Torches, Redstone Repeaters, Piston, etc.

Blocks/Items: All other things that do not fit into any of the other categories
Enchanted items
After a while, many players accumulate several double chests each of other things
Stuff you rarely need
Items that are hard to obtain, rare items
Examples: Dragon Egg, Nether Star, Heart of the Sea, etc.

Blocks/Items: Useful on a multiplayer server where you are bunking with friends. This way, they know if they can borrow some dirt, or if all of your stuff has an invisible "HANDS OFF!" sign on it.
